_note: Questions real users asked Nessie on production, grouped by the plain-words issue each one tests (the _issues block). Inline cases (uq.<issue>.<n>) hold a user's question word for word, multi-turn where a later turn leans on an earlier one; uq.<issue>.s<n> is a sibling: the same kind of question about another record. A question the corpus already holds word for word is named in include_ids instead of copied. Tags: user, issue:<slug>, verbatim or sibling, member (run as a non-admin project member, or the case tests nothing), unverified (no measured truth: behaviour criteria only). Numbers are production counts read 2026-11-18; re-read them before trusting a red. Every inline case needs NESSIE_ON_PROD=1. Check with python -m NessieAI.tests.nessie_tests.case_file_check <file> --instance prod. The two-per-issue selection is user_questions_run2.json and user_questions_run2-member.json.
